# coolify_s3_storages (Data Source)

Use this data source to list all Coolify S3 storages. Requires Coolify >= v4.3.0.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coolify_s3_storages" "all" {}

output "s3_storage_names" {
  value = [for s in data.coolify_s3_storages.all.s3_storages : s.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filter results by field values. Multiple filters are ANDed together. Multiple values within a filter are ORed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))

### Read-Only

- `s3_storages` (Attributes List) The list of S3 storages. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--s3_storages))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The field name to filter by.
- `values` (Set of String) The values to match against. Multiple values are ORed.


<a id="nestedatt--s3_storages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `s3_storages`

Read-Only:

- `bucket` (String) S3 bucket name.
- `description` (String) Description of the S3 storage.
- `endpoint` (String) S3-compatible endpoint URL.
- `is_usable` (Boolean) Whether Coolify marks this storage as usable.
- `name` (String) A friendly name for the S3 storage.
- `region` (String) S3 region.
- `uuid` (String) The unique identifier of the S3 storage.
